column1: Greets the client and introduces self (1/2 mk)
Enquires about her general well being and her family (1/4 mk)
Introduces the topic to the client (1/2 mk)
Assesses the clients pre-entry knowledge by asking questions on diet generally (1/4 mk)
Mentions the classes of food; carbohydrate, proteins, fats & oil, minerals, water, vitamins and roughage. (1mk)
States the importance of taking regular intake of adequate diet in pregnancy
development of fetus and alleviation of minor disorders of pregnancy (1mk)
Emphasises the need for increased protein intake with reason for growth of new tissues  (1/2 mk)
Mentions the two minerals that are vital in pregnancy  iron and calcium (1 mk)
Uses local inexpensive dietary examples to explain an adequate meal (1mk)
Occasionally refers to information supplied by client during pre-entry assessment by supporting certain impressions or discouraging some  (1 mk)
Asks if client has any question   (1 mk)
